exposure: gestational age at diagnosis of FGR
fetal growth restriction (FGR) diagnosed before 28 weeks of gestation
gestational age at diagnosis of fetal growth restriction (FGR)
estimated fetal weight or abdominal circumference below the third centile
outcome: survival to discharge from neonatal care
cohort: Singleton births between 22 and 31 weeks of gestation without severe congenital anomalies in 25 French regions in 2011
finding: Earlier gestational age at FGR diagnosis was associated with a lower probability of live birth and survival to discharge, even after adjusting for other perinatal characteristics.
mod_finding: The majority (94.1%) of live births were by prelabor cesarean section, mainly due to maternal indications before 26 weeks.
